title: Mac release manifest transport
objective: Carry both exact SEA build manifests through protected macOS signing and package them with an internally verified SHA256SUMS inventory

oracles: Exact signing-input member and digest regression
Exact ZIP member and internal SHA256SUMS regression

handoff.summary: The protected handoff authenticates both executables and both SEA build manifests, the signed ZIP carries the exact restored manifests plus a complete internal SHA256SUMS inventory, and Apple secrets are confined to the first-party macos-15 signer.
risks: The dynamic ZIP extraction/signature test is macOS-only and is intentionally skipped by the recorded Linux validation receipt.
next_steps: Run the full unsigned archive witness on macOS after integration into the frozen release authority.
Run signing and notarization only from an approved release-candidate tag.
